title: Peak Energy Window
body: Your LH surge has triggered ovulation. Estrogen is at peak, testosterone gets a little boost, and you're at the height of physical and social energy. This window doesn't last long — enjoy it.
tip: Lean into social plans and creative work — you're in your zone.

title: Words Flow Easily
body: Verbal fluency peaks during ovulation. Studies show people perform better on word recall, complex conversation, and articulation tasks during this window. If you've got a big talk — today's the day.
tip: Difficult conversation you've been avoiding? Today is good for it.

title: Side Twinges Are Normal
body: Some people feel a sharp twinge on one side of their lower abdomen during ovulation — it's called mittelschmerz (German for 'middle pain'). It's the follicle releasing and is medically normal.
tip: Note which side. Tracking ovulation side over time is genuinely useful info.

title: Libido High
body: It's not just hype — libido genuinely peaks around ovulation. Testosterone is up, estrogen is high, and your body is biologically primed for connection. Honor it however feels right to you.
tip: Notice without judgment. Your body is doing exactly what biology designed.

title: Athletic Edge

tip: Try to lift heavier or run faster today. Just by 5%. See what happens.

title: Social Sparkle
body: Many people report feeling more outgoing, magnetic, and confident during ovulation. It's tied to hormonal changes that subtly affect skin, voice pitch, and even facial symmetry.
tip: If you've been putting off seeing friends — today is the day to plan it.

title: Window Closing
body: Ovulation is brief — usually only 24-48 hours of egg viability. The 'peak' energy window is similarly short. If you're still in ovulatory phase by day 8+, you may already be transitioning toward luteal.
tip: Notice the subtle shift. Your body is starting to prepare for the next phase.

body: Ovulation week is short — three or four days of peak vitality and clarity. If you've been getting good ideas or feeling strong, write them down. Future-you in luteal will be grateful.
tip: Voice-memo or quick-note any ideas or insights from this week.

title: Cervical Mucus 101
body: Cervical mucus changes throughout your cycle and is one of the most reliable fertility signals. Around ovulation it's clear and stretchy (like egg white). After ovulation it dries up.
tip: Notice the change today vs. yesterday. Tracking this is genuinely powerful info.

companionVariants.owl: Sage notes: spinnbarkeit (mucus stretchiness) signals fertility 🦉
companionVariants.blossom: Body literacy is power 🩷 Knowledge is a gift

title: Late Ovulation
body: If you're tracking ovulation by day 12-14 of your cycle, you're in classic timing — this is when most people ovulate. The two weeks after this are your luteal phase, governed by progesterone.
tip: Notice the transition. Your body is shifting into a calmer, slower energy.

title: Body Temp Rises
body: After ovulation, your basal body temperature rises about 0.3°C and stays elevated until your next period. If you track BBT, the rise confirms ovulation happened.
tip: If you're temperature-tracking, take it first thing in the morning before getting up.

title: Wrap Up Strong
body: The end of ovulation is a great time to wrap loose ends — emails, errands, decisions. Your executive function is still sharp before progesterone shifts your brain into a slower, more reflective gear.
tip: Clear your inbox, finish the thing, then rest into luteal.
